card.title: PS5 SSD Controller Current Draw and Fuse Isolation Procedure

claims.statement: A working SSD circuit draws 310mA; discrepancies indicate a faulty SSD controller IC.
claims.evidence: Current consumption measurement via fuse F7520 pads.
claims.quote: Good working SSD circuit draws: 310mA. If current is different on a faulty board change the SSD controller IC.

procedure: Remove fuse F7520 feeding voltage to the voltage regulator generating power for the SSD circuit.
Set a multimeter in current mode in series with the pads of the fuse.
Measure current draw to verify against the expected 310mA draw.

measurements.context: In-series measurement across removed fuse F7520

card.caveats: Ensure proper meter fusing before taking series current measurements.
